review.headline: 16 km long run completed at a steady, even 5:48/km, squarely within the easy band.
observations: Distance 15.995 km against a 16 km target, with moving time 5550 s (92.5 min) at 5:47/km average.
Pace held almost perfectly even: 15 splits at 5:48/km, one at 5:38 (km 9) and a final 0.995 km at 5:48.
Average HR 142 and cadence 174 spm; HR stayed flat across all splits, consistent with an unhurried aerobic effort.
Pace sits inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy range and is slower than the 4:54 marathon reference, matching the 'steady and unhurried' intent.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so subjective effort cannot be confirmed.
Average HR of 142 is somewhat high for easy running relative to the 138 HR on the 2026-11-05 easy run at a similar pace.
Elevation gain of 181.8 m was not in the plan description; may have added effort on hills.
